subject: School HVAC Infrastructure and Roof Bonds
overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole reviewed a proposed $5 million Phase 1 bond authorization for HVAC replacements and roof repairs at the Andrews Middle School and McGlynn Complex. No formal vote was taken ahead of the paper's consideration at the regular meeting.

items.title: School HVAC Infrastructure and Roof Loan Order (Paper 24510)
items.summary: School and city staff presented plans and cost estimates for a $5 million Phase 1 bond to fund equipment pre-purchases and engineering for HVAC overhauls and roof refurbishment at the Andrews and McGlynn schools. No formal committee action was required because the loan order was scheduled for a third reading at the regular meeting.
